'''FC Neman Grodno''' or '''FK Nyoman Hrodna''' ({{langx|be|ФК Нёман Гродна}}; {{langx|ru|ФК Неман Гродно}}) is a Belarusian professional [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Grodno]]. It is named after the [[Neman River]] and founded in 1964. Since 1992, the team has participated in the highest division of Belarusian football league system."}}
